svg.title: House of Jars: 2nd floor plan
svg.desc: A plan of the 2nd floor of House of Jars, street at the bottom: Dorm J (14 pods, 14 lockers), Landing, Men's bathroom. Not photographed yet: copied from the 1st floor on the owner's word.
